summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, disclosing a lender-approved extension of its Credit Agreement waivers to October 1, 2026. Silver Point Finance, as Administrative Agent, and Lenders extended temporary relief from minimum liquidity and Collateral Coverage Ratio covenants, marking the latest in a series dating to June 25. The Company, advised by a special board committee, is actively evaluating strategic alternatives, including financing, recapitalization, restructuring, and M&A, and cites significant progress in third-party discussions. Watch for covenant breach risk absent a permanent waiver or transaction; near-term extension dependency remains the key arbitrage angle.
